title: WaterColor 34 Crossvine Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:-Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 8 wristbands.- Fully-equipped gourmet kitchen- Theater surround-sound system in living room- Additional office space- Four large porches for relaxing - two open and two screened- 4-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Gas grill- Outdoor shower- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant-ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout.- Two blocks from Camp Watercolor- Two blocks from PublixDETAILS: This charming 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom Main House—plus Carriage House—exemplifies what WaterColor living is all about! 34 Crossvine Circle is professionally decorated with the quintessential luxury beach style, including 4 large porches for relaxing. It’s conveniently located on a quiet, private lot surrounded by nature while only being a couple of blocks from Camp WaterColor and within walking distance of all the amenities that downtown WaterColor has to offer.The first floor of this 2-story home is undoubtedly the heart, with an elegant great room to gather with family. The open living area features a beautiful white slip-covered couch and 3 plush armchairs around the fireplace with a wall-mounted TV and surround sound overhead. An equally impressive kitchen is outfitted with custom green cabinetry, premium appliances, and a gorgeous tile backsplash. The dining and kitchen areas can easily seat 11 guests at the breakfast bar, island, and dining table. When guests want to enjoy a family movie night or simply entertain the kids, the TV room on this floor is the perfect solution. In a more tranquil corner of the house is a quiet screened-in porch with a cozy sitting area and an alfresco dining table. Spend a sunny afternoon entertaining guests on the gorgeous back patio that separates the Main House from the Carriage House with a picnic dinner fresh from the BBQ grill or while enjoying a glass of wine around the firepit.Upstairs are 3 guest bedrooms and a laundry room. There are 2 primary bedrooms with king beds, private bathrooms, and spacious decks—one is screened in and the other is open—and 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed, private bathroom, and unobstructed views of the area.The Carriage House has an A-framed bedroom ceiling with a king bed and private bathroom, as well as a coffee bar with a mini fridge for convenience.34 Crossvine Circle provides comfortable accommodations for the whole family! With on-site parking, plus 5 adult bikes and a 4-passenger golf cart, it’s easy to explore the area. Check availability for this wonderful WaterColor home and book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Common Bath with ShowerSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Second Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubCARRIAGE HOUSE:- King Bed, Private Bathroom with shower and coffee bar and fridge.*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.*Unfortunately no pets allowed in this home at anytime.
